title: Rory and the Silver Moss Valley
verses:
The sun sank away as the shadows grew long,
And Rory walked slow through the breeze in the glade.
A cricket hummed softly a slumbering song,
While stars lit the canopy evening had made.

Above all the trees, Nia drifted in grace,
She spotted a hollow where silver moss grew.
She signaled the herd to this cozy old place,
Where blossoms were bathed in the night-colored dew.

Then Benny stepped down near the edge of the stream,
And lay on the ground with a rumble so deep.
And Ricky stopped bouncing to pause in a dream,
As all of his energy faded to sleep.

Then Tilly swept leaves in a pile for a bed,
To make a snug nest on the velvet-green floor.
Psittaco yawned gently and rested his head,
While shadows stretched out by the quiet lake shore.

Now Rory curled close to his friends in a ring,
As moonlight dripped down from the branches above.
The night rustled soft like a whispering wing,
Enfolding the valley in calm and in love.

The sleepy world hushed under blankets of night,
Each friend drifted off to a dream-laden sleep.
The stars kept their watch in the silvery light,
While darkness grew still in the valley so deep.
